description:
A desktop terminal for running multiple CLI agents in parallel sessions.

PATerminal provides parallel terminal sessions, split panes, session resume,
agent status, and Git tools for CLI agent workflows on Windows and macOS.
CLI agents must be installed and authenticated separately.
Official builds include a 30-day trial of all features. Advanced features
require a license after the trial. The source is available under a proprietary license.
Changes
- Filter the sidebar by group. A "Groups" toggle next to the Whole row opens a row of chips, one per top-level group. Select one or more chips to show only the sessions in those groups (nested groups come along with their top-level group). The filter combines with search, the status tabs and the recent order. While the row is collapsed, the toggle shows how many groups are selected.
- Filter the sidebar by when you last typed. A new select at the start of the filter row narrows the list to sessions you typed into today, or within the last 3 or 7 days. Days are counted by calendar day, matching each session's "today / yesterday / N days ago" badge. Sessions that were only opened do not count. The filter combines with the status tabs and search; the archive view ignores it.
Neither filter is saved between launches, matching the status tabs. Labels in languages other than Japanese and English are machine-translated.
macOS Universal and Windows x64 installers are attached by the release workflow. This release becomes Latest after the build and updater signature checks succeed.
